path.id: Cole Abrams, Maia Gonzalez, Carolyn Hoa, Lucy Liu

Sue Harnett is the Founder & CEO of Rewriting the Code, the nonprofit she launched in 2017 that has grown into a global community of 38,000+ university and early-career women in tech, offering mentorship, education, and career-readiness programs. She will be speaking about women in technology, and the value of community, teamwork, and thoughtful leadership!
